Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the correct birth years (Fulci 1927, Humberstone 1901) by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release dates and concluding that Fulci was born earlier. This is logically incorrect; Humberstone (1901) was born earlier than Fulci (1927), so the correct film is Charlie Chan in Honolulu.
